shots.what_happens: Long 28 s screen recording under the VO on integrations (w72-w132). It opens on the Run Tasks list; the cursor hovers rows and opens the 'Import Actuals from Workday via CCDS' task. The form loads (Apr 2021 period, From Source System version).
